facts: DefaultAppearanceFile and DefaultRecoveryDirectory use os.UserConfigDir plus ELab
Native setup accepts custom recovery-directory and appearance-file flags; no-recovery/no-appearance disable those stores
Non-smoke Cogent desktop DataDir uses user.Current().HomeDir/Library, independent of those ELab flags
CogentCoreDataDir joins DataDir with Cogent Core; geometry files use window-geometry-0.3.6.json/lst/lck
Only smoke mode sets DisableWindowGeometrySaver before app initialization
No ordinary current-account launch or HOME reassignment was performed; separate account or VM availability was asked asynchronously
